title: The Ultimate Character Questionnaire and Worksheet (over 200 character questions)
use_cases: Use when developing backstories for fictional protagonists or antagonists
Use when fleshing out secondary characters to add realism and depth
Implement when brainstorming character motivations and personality traits
Use when preparing initial drafts or character bibles for long-form fiction
content: The Character Questionnaire is a list of questions, put into groups, to help prompt writers to add detail and depth to their characters.
